data.body: Compaction budget model is now an Adashi design specification: aworkit.workflow_worker.context_compaction_budget, "Compaction budget model: a quarter-window target and a derived floor" (2026-09-26, commit 3173c99). Linked to the harness context element and the compaction sequence artifact, and bound to the compaction modules, run_events.rs and the policy symbols; design health reports it resolved with 0 broken bindings. It supersedes the R/U/S budget model of c848df3 and note compaction-64k-floor-provenance: the retained tail is no longer a ratio, there is no carried-user budget, and the 64k floor is now derived from the measured fixed context (59,648 at 12,400). Open follow-ups: task 144 (segmented summary or fitting lossy drop), task 145 (the retainRatio setting and docs/context-compaction.md still describe the superseded model).
